title: City Hideaway with Stunning Rooftop Escape #2
description:
Newly built home designed just for YOU! Close to the Gulch, Mid-town and Downtown Nashville (6-8 minutes). This 3 LEVEL ROOFTOP townhome is spacious and has plenty of room for large groups. The home features 4 bedrooms/4 bathrooms, a fully equipped kitchen, and a private rooftop with a hot tub making for the ultimate getaway to relax and/or mingle as you view the city lights of Downtown Nashville. Look no further as you are 2-3 miles away from all the best Nashville scenes and attractions!

The space
Comes with a fully equipped kitchen, two sets of washers and dryers, and plenty of space making this your *luxurious* home away from home. The first floor has the first set of washer/dryer with a king bedroom with a full bathroom attached. The second floor makes for the ultimate entertainment space with a full kitchen and living/dining area that can comfortably entertain all your guests. The second floor also has a bedroom with a queen bed, a full bathroom, and a queen air mattress located in the bedroom closet. The third floor houses the second set of washer/dryer, two bedrooms; one with a queen bed and one with two queen beds. Each bedroom has it's own full bathroom. Last but not least, the amazing rooftop has an outdoor seating area with your own personal hot tub with amazing views of the city.
